name: Vyapar Books PRO
releaseNotes: Cloud sync link is now preserved across app updates and browser-storage resets
Configured CouchDB URLs are never auto-deleted, including URLs hosted on custom domains
Added Test Connection diagnostics for read access, write permission, CORS, and authentication
Sync errors now surface in Settings instead of showing a false Cloud Synced status
Service worker no longer caches CouchDB/PouchDB or cross-origin sync traffic
Full backups now include the configured sync link so restore can reconnect automatically
